audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Cassiopeia 6 of 7 stages at a 50.93% Aurelion Sol win rate, and three rows disagreed between phases[N].side and win[N] (rows 4, 5 and 6).
audit.why: Cassiopeia genuinely owns levels 1-5 through Noxious Blast and Miasma zoning, but a near-even win rate cannot come from a chart that gives her everything up to two items.
audit.corrected: Cassiopeia 1/2/3/4-5, Skill at 6, Aurelion Sol at first item and 2+ items — proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text names Shadowflame/Stormsurge as the first-item spike while report[8] builds Rod of Ages first.
audit.why: The page told the player two different first items in the same matchup.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2] around the Rod of Ages health spike and E's execute clear from outside Twin Fang's 700 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Miasma grounds Astral Flight, and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies who are facing her.
audit.why: Astral Flight is Aurelion Sol's only escape and Miasma's grounding disables it outright — the page said 'dashes and leaps' generically without naming his W. Riot's own text for Petrifying Gaze says enemies with their back turned are slowed instead of stunned, which is the difference between dying and walking away.
audit.corrected: Both stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and enemyWin, with Miasma's 24s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun and no reason given.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that heals for a percentage of damage dealt; that is what makes long trades unwinnable, and the flagged needs-antiheal interaction was never explained.
audit.corrected: Named Twin Fang and its 0.75s cadence as the reason to buy Grievous Wounds before extended trades.

edits.before: Petrify into Twin Fang is a real kill-threat combo you can't out-damage or out-position yet
edits.after: Falling Star trades with Petrifying Gaze, and turning your back downgrades hers to a slow

edits.before: You're still one item behind the breakpoint needed to out-trade her burst combo
edits.after: Rod of Ages plus E executes let you clear from outside Twin Fang's 700 range

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Check it before every step-up. - W Astral Flight is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and grounds Astral Flight — inside the cloud your escape does not exist, so never fly through it. - Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her; turn your back and it is just a slow.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Miasma grounds Astral Flight — no flying out of it, and rank 1 is 24s down. Step up on that timer.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by grounding you in Miasma, then Petrifying Gaze into Twin Fang while you cannot fly away.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by outranging her: your 750 beam and 1250 R start fights outside Twin Fang's 700, and she has no dash to close the gap you keep.

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her off every poison tick — long trades refill her.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Rod of Ages rush (or Seraph's), then Archangel's, Liandry's, Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive comps. Never skip the mana battery. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Rod of Ages rush (or Seraph's), then Archangel's, Liandry's, Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive comps. Twin Fang heals her every 0.75s — buy anti-heal before extended trades.

edits.before: Rylai's/Liandry's timers make her poke-into-DOT loop nearly unanswerable through minions, but Aurelion Sol's Shadowflame or Stormsurge spike gives you the range and burst to start winning trades back.
edits.after: Rylai's and Liandry's make her poison loop nearly unanswerable through minions, but Rod of Ages gives you the health to survive one Petrify chain and E's execute clears the wave from outside Twin Fang range.

notes: Several fields use 'his' for Cassiopeia (tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.wave, phases[3].why, report[3], report[9]). I did not propose pronoun-only rewrites where the sentence was otherwise fine, but a sweep for 'his' on female champions would be worth running repo-wide. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d both contain the tradeGood/tradeBad strings verbatim rather than descriptions matching their titles — same structural bug seen on brand.
